evidence: Title 'Feature: Add to Cart — Acceptance Criteria'
Six Given/When/Then criteria AC-CART-1..6 with no story or narrative

requirements.text: A shopper can add a product to the cart from the product detail page

acceptance_criteria.text: Adding an in-stock product adds it with quantity 1, increments the cart icon count by 1 and shows toast 'Added to cart'
Adding a product already in the cart increases the existing line's quantity by 1 instead of creating a new line
Selected quantity must be a whole number between 1 and 10 inclusive
Adding to a line with quantity 10 shows 'You can buy a maximum of 10 units of this item' and the quantity stays 10
Requesting more than the available stock shows 'Only <n> left in stock' and nothing is added
A guest's items are stored in a guest cart and merged into the account cart on login

business_rules.text: An add that would take a cart line above 10 units is rejected with the maximum message and the line keeps its quantity

clarifications.question: If a line has quantity 8 and the shopper adds 3 more, is the add rejected, capped at 10, or allowed?
clarifications.why: AC-CART-4 only covers a line already at 10.

clarifications.question: How is an invalid quantity (0, 11, 2.5, empty) rejected: the selector prevents it, or an error message is shown?
clarifications.why: AC-CART-3 states the range but not the rejection behaviour or message.

clarifications.question: When the guest cart and account cart contain the same product, are quantities summed, and is the 10-unit cap applied?
clarifications.why: AC-CART-6 states merging but not the conflict rule.

clarifications.question: Does the cart icon count total units or distinct lines (e.g. after AC-CART-2)?
clarifications.why: AC-CART-1 says +1 for a new product; behaviour on quantity increase is unstated.

assumptions.text: An add that would exceed 10 units on a line is rejected with 'You can buy a maximum of 10 units of this item' and the line quantity is unchanged.
Quantities outside 1-10 or non-whole numbers cannot be added: the cart is unchanged (message text unspecified).
